name: take_photo
description: Take a photo using the device camera.

timer_seconds.description: Optional countdown timer in seconds before taking the photo.

name: record_video
description: Start or stop recording a video.

name: open_gallery
description: Open the photo gallery or a specific album.

name: share_photo
description: Share the most recent photo or a specified photo with a contact.

photo_description.description: Description to identify which photo, e.g. 'last photo', 'screenshot'.

name: take_burst_photos
description: Take a burst of photos in quick succession.

count.description: Optional number of photos to take in the burst.

name: edit_photo
description: Edit a photo with a specified action.

filter_name.description: Optional filter name when action is 'filter' e.g. 'sepia', 'noir', 'vivid'.

photo_description.description: Description to identify the photo to delete.

name: search_photos
description: Search photos by keyword or description.
